stories.title: Escuinapa enfrenta alerta del huracán Simon sin coordinador de protección civil tras su asesinato; alistan albergues

en.title: Escuinapa faces Hurricane Simon alert without civil protection coordinator following his assassination; shelters being prepared
en.summary: Escuinapa is responding to Hurricane Simon while lacking a civil protection coordinator after the official's murder. The state prosecutor's office is investigating the killing.

stories.title: Arrestan a la actriz Selma Blair tras altercado en vuelo de Los Ángeles a Nueva York

en.title: Actress Selma Blair arrested following altercation on Los Angeles to New York flight
en.summary: Selma Blair was detained at John F. Kennedy Airport after a Delta Air Lines flight landed, following reports of a passenger engaging in physical violence.

stories.title: Detienen a 5 extranjeros frente a costas de Oaxaca; les decomisan 1.2 toneladas de cocaína

en.title: 5 foreigners detained off Oaxaca coast; 1.2 tons of cocaine seized
en.summary: Mexican and U.S. authorities deployed naval and aerial units to intercept a vessel carrying suspected illegal cargo in Pacific Ocean waters.

stories.title: Tamaulipas inicia Campaña Estatal de Vacunación 2026; reporta cero casos de sarampión

en.title: Tamaulipas launches 2026 State Vaccination Campaign; reports zero measles cases
en.summary: Tamaulipas has initiated its 2026 state vaccination campaign and reported no measles cases in the region.

stories.title: Cuba niega cualquier vínculo con 90 cargamentos de combustible; fue interceptado cuando se dirigía a la isla, dice Washington

en.title: Cuba denies any link to 90 fuel shipments; was intercepted while heading to island, says Washington
en.summary: Cuba has denied involvement with 90 fuel shipments that Washington says it intercepted en route to the island. The U.S. currently allows only fuel purchased domestically by Cuban private entrepreneurs to enter Cuba.

stories.title: Aseguran 1.2 toneladas de cocaína en costas de Oaxaca

en.title: 1.2 tons of cocaine seized off Oaxaca coast
en.summary: Mexican naval forces, working with U.S. Coast Guard, seized a vessel carrying 1.2 tons of cocaine off the coast of Oaxaca and detained six individuals.

stories.title: Donovan Carrillo se corona en el Tayside Trophy 2026; rompe su récord personal

en.title: Donovan Carrillo wins 2026 Tayside Trophy; breaks personal record
en.summary: Donovan Carrillo won the 2026 Tayside Trophy competition and set a new personal record in the process.

stories.title: Familias de detenidos en marcha por el agua en Guadalajara denuncian abusos; exigen cotejar listas ante posibles desapariciones

en.title: Families of detainees in water march in Guadalajara report abuses; demand verification of lists amid possible disappearances
en.summary: Relatives of people arrested during a water protest in Guadalajara allege illegal detentions, excessive force, and incommunicado detention, and deny those arrested include riot group members.

stories.title: VIDEO: México y EU lanzan operativo en altamar; detienen a 7 personas y aseguran 1.2 toneladas de cocaína

en.title: VIDEO: Mexico and US launch offshore operation; detain 7 people and seize 1.2 tons of cocaine
en.summary: Mexico and the United States conducted a joint maritime operation that resulted in the detention of seven individuals and the seizure of 1.2 tons of cocaine.

stories.title: Cuba niega vínculos con 90 cargamentos de combustible interceptados por Estados Unidos

en.title: Cuba denies links to 90 fuel shipments intercepted by United States
en.summary: Cuba denied involvement with 90 fuel shipments that U.S. authorities say they intercepted while en route to the island amid an eight-month U.S. petroleum embargo.

stories.title: Pone en marcha Américo Campaña Estatal de Vacunación 2026

en.title: Americo launches State Vaccination Campaign 2026
en.summary: A state vaccination campaign was initiated in Tamaulipas, which has reported no measles cases and no dengue deaths.

stories.title: Arrestan a Selma Blair por presunta agresión en un avión

en.title: Selma Blair arrested for alleged assault on an airplane
en.summary: Actress Selma Blair was arrested following allegations that she assaulted two flight attendants and attempted to open a plane door during a flight to New York.

stories.title: Nobel de Economía 2026 distingue a analistas de modelos en hogares y empresas que ayudan a gobiernos a enfrentar crisis

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics honors analysts of household and business models helping governments face crises
en.summary: Americans Robert E. Hall from Stanford and Michael Woodford received the Nobel Prize in Economics for their contributions to the microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilization.

stories.title: ¿Cómo desarrollar talento y liderazgo en la era de la Inteligencia Artificial?

en.title: How to develop talent and leadership in the era of Artificial Intelligence?
en.summary: Collaboration between academic institutions and industry is essential for advancing knowledge, technology and experience needed to cultivate leadership and innovative solutions.

stories.title: Querétaro y el siguiente capítulo de la economía digital de México

en.title: Querétaro and the next chapter of Mexico's digital economy
en.summary: Data centers growth could position Querétaro as a strategic hub for AI economy, though challenges remain in providing sufficient electricity, water efficiency and infrastructure.

stories.title: La violencia en Sinaloa encarece los seguros y deja a conductores y transportistas más desprotegidos

en.title: Violence in Sinaloa drives up insurance costs and leaves drivers and transporters more unprotected
en.summary: Insurance premiums in Sinaloa have surged up to 400 percent for transporters, while life insurance contracting has grown significantly according to financial regulator data.

stories.title: ¿Tu hijo tiene TDAH? Esta startup mexicana busca adaptar las clases a sus necesidades

en.title: Does your child have ADHD? This Mexican startup seeks to adapt classes to their needs
en.summary: A Mexican EdTech company called Emmi uses artificial intelligence to personalize educational activities for preschool and primary school students, reaching over 12,000 children while reducing teachers' administrative burden.
